entries.title: Zechariah 14:1
segments: ¶See, a day of the Lord is coming when they will make division of your goods taken by force before your eyes.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:2
segments: For I will get all the nations together to make war against Jerusalem; and the town will be overcome, and the goods taken from the houses, and the women taken by force: and half the town will go away as prisoners, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the town.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:3
segments: Then the Lord will go out and make war against those nations, as he did in the day of the fight.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:4
segments: And in that day his feet will be on the Mount of Olives, which is opposite Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives will be parted in the middle to the east and to the west, forming a very great valley; and half the mountain will be moved to the north and half of it to the south.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:5
segments: And the valley will be stopped...and you will go in flight as you went in flight from the earth-shock in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah: and the Lord my God will come, and all his holy ones with him.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:6
segments: And in that day there will be no heat or cold or ice;

entries.title: Zechariah 14:7
segments: And it will be unbroken day, such as the Lord has knowledge of, without change of day and night, and even at nightfall it will be light.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:8
segments: ¶And on that day living waters will go out from Jerusalem; half of them flowing to the sea on the east and half to the sea on the west: in summer and in winter it will be so.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:9
segments: And the Lord will be King over all the earth: in that day there will be one Lord and his name one.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:10
segments: And all the land will become like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and be living in her place; from the doorway of Benjamin to the place of the first doorway, to the doorway of the angle, and from the tower of Hananel to the king's wine-crushing places, men will be living in her.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:11
segments: And there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will be living without fear of danger.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:12
segments: And this will be the disease which the Lord will send on all the peoples which have been warring against Jerusalem: their flesh will be wasted away while they are on their feet, their eyes will be wasted in their heads and their tongues in their mouths.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:13
segments: And it will be on that day that a great fear will be sent among them from the Lord; and everyone will take his neighbour's hand, and every man's hand will be lifted against his neighbour's.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:14
segments: And even Judah will be fighting against Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations round about will be massed together, a great store of gold and silver and clothing.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:15
segments: And the horses and the transport beasts, the camels and the asses and all the beasts in those tents will be attacked by the same disease.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:16
segments: ¶And it will come about that everyone who is still living, of all those nations who came against Jerusalem, will go up from year to year to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, and to keep the feast of tents.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:17
segments: And it will be that if any one of all the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, on them there will be no rain.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:18
segments: And if the family of Egypt does not go up or come there, they will be attacked by the disease which the Lord will send on the nations:

entries.title: Zechariah 14:19
segments: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations who do not go up to keep the feast of tents.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:20
segments: On that day all the bells of the horses will be holy to the Lord, and the pots in the Lord's house will be like the basins before the altar.

entries.title: Zechariah 14:21
segments: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the Lord of armies: and all those who make offerings will come and take them for boiling their offerings: in that day there will be no more traders in the house of the Lord of armies.
